# GenCatalog

> GenCatalog is a local-first library for AI-generated images and videos, with a Mac and Windows desktop app, a Chrome capture extension, and an iPhone and iPad companion in public TestFlight beta. It brings media, prompts, source context, notes, tags, ratings, and available generation metadata into one searchable catalog on the customer's Mac or Windows PC. GenCatalog does not upload the creative library to cloud storage.

## Canonical facts

- Price: $99 per year, billed annually, plus applicable taxes.
- Subscribe: [Start the annual subscription](https://secondactlabs.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/33e4fb54-df7e-4135-b850-b7fe008a7ddb).
- Free trial: 7 days or 250 saved generations, whichever comes first; no credit card is required.
- Existing-library access: after the first successful payment, everything already in the catalog remains fully accessible if the customer later cancels or lets the subscription lapse.
- Grandfathered customers: customers who purchased a perpetual license before the subscription transition keep the perpetual access and update rights included with that purchase and do not need to subscribe.
- Desktop platforms: macOS and Windows 10/11.
- Mobile companion: iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS), in free public TestFlight beta, with an adaptive layout designed for iPhone Duo. Requires the desktop app and a library to connect.
- Architecture: local-first, with media and library data stored on the customer's computer or chosen external storage. There is no GenCatalog cloud library or account requirement.

## iPhone and iPad companion beta

A free public TestFlight beta is available for iPhone and iPad, with an adaptive layout designed for iPhone Duo. It requires GenCatalog for Mac or Windows and an existing library to connect. Browse creations and their available prompts/details, play videos, and explicitly keep selected originals on device for offline use. Favoriting alone does not download an original. A reachable, awake desktop running GenCatalog is required for refresh and unsaved media; remote access requires separate Tailscale configuration. New capture and import remain desktop workflows.

- Mobile overview and beta entry: https://gencatalog.app/mobile
- Connection and troubleshooting: https://gencatalog.app/support#mobile
